system.name: SpeContext
system.one_liner: an algorithm-system co-design that uses a distilled LM to speculatively identify and prefetch sparse KV cache for long-context LLM reasoning

components.name: Layer_l
components.role: one decoding layer performing QKV projection, KV cache retrieve-and-load, and attention

components.name: KV Cache Retrieve and Load
components.role: existing paradigm's layer-wise retrieval operation, the source of synchronization overhead

components.name: Selected KV Cache
components.role: KV pairs selected by retrieval and offloaded to GPU HBM / CPU DRAM

components.name: Original LLM
components.role: baseline model performing full, non-sparse attention for comparison

components.name: Distilled LM (DLM)
components.role: small distilled model whose attention focus is used as a speculative retrieval proxy for the original LLM

components.name: Efficient Retrieval Alg.
components.role: retrieval algorithm whose accuracy objective is aligned with the LLM's accuracy

components.name: Lightweight Retrieval head
components.role: pruned DLM component (~0.03B params) that selects important tokens before LLM inference

components.name: Asynchronous prefetch dataflow / Elastic Loading
components.role: prefetches only the differing KV pairs between adjacent decoding steps in parallel with LLM inference

components.name: Adaptive memory management system
components.role: allocates GPU HBM / CPU DRAM memory across LLM layers using a theoretical memory model

flows.what: token input to the decoding pipeline
pruning to a lightweight retrieval head

content.key_idea: Existing layer-wise KV retrieval is slow and inflexible for long-context reasoning, but a distilled LM's attention focus mirrors the original LLM's, motivating SpeContext's three contributions: a lightweight retrieval head, an asynchronous elastic-loading prefetch dataflow, and adaptive memory management.
content.reading_order: Left panel (a) walks through the existing decoding-phase pipeline and its three numbered challenges; middle panel (b) shows the key insight that a distilled LM mirrors the original LLM's information focus; right panel (c) maps that insight onto three contributions C1-C3 tied to later sections.

summary: This three-panel motivation/overview figure introduces SpeContext, a system for efficient long-context LLM reasoning. Panel (a) walks through the existing decoding-phase pipeline (per-layer QKV, KV Cache Retrieve and Load, Attention) and annotates three challenges: time-consuming layer-wise retrieval (up to 60% overhead), complete retention of newly generated KV pairs, and performance degradation with growing sequence length, illustrated with offload to GPU HBM/CPU DRAM. Panel (b) shows the paper's key insight: a Distilled LM (DLM) exhibits attention focus similar to the Original LLM, so retrieval accuracy can be aligned with model accuracy, illustrated with a shared-answer example. Panel (c) maps this insight to three contributions labeled C1-C3: a lightweight retrieval head pruned from the DLM, an asynchronous prefetch dataflow with elastic loading, and an adaptive memory management system, each tied to its later section. Colors distinguish existing-paradigm problems (red/gray) from the paper's own insight and contributions (green).
summary_zh: 该图分三部分概述SpeContext：(a) 现有解码流程中KV缓存逐层检索带来的三大挑战（延迟、完整保留新KV、序列增长性能退化）；(b) 关键洞察——蒸馏小模型与原始LLM的注意力关注点相似；(c) 据此提出的三项贡献C1轻量检索头、C2异步弹性预取、C3自适应内存管理，分别对应后续章节。
